name: Landing
description: A landing address that accepts BCH from anyone and lets it leave only to its owner: converted to a fungible CashToken at or above a minimum rate, or returned as BCH once the coin is old enough. No key is needed to finish.

payer.name: Payer
payer.description: Pays BCH to the landing address. Can also return a coin to the owner once it is old enough.

converter.name: Converter
converter.description: Pays the owner the tokens for a landed coin at or above the minimum rate and takes its satoshis.

land.name: Land
land.description: Pay $(<landedSatoshis>) satoshis to the landing address of the owner.

payer.name: Land
payer.description: Fund the landing output and state the owner, the token category, the minimum rate and the return age.

convert.name: Convert
convert.description: Pay the owner at least $(convertTokenAmount) tokens and take the $(<landedSatoshis>) landed satoshis.

converter.name: Convert
converter.description: Provide one token coin as input 1, the network fee, and the locking script that receives the payout.

giveBack.name: Give back
giveBack.description: Return the $(<landedSatoshis>) landed satoshis to the owner as BCH, less the network fee.

payer.name: Give back
payer.description: Anyone may do this once the coin is $(<returnAfter>) blocks old. No key is needed.

landTransaction.name: Landed
landTransaction.description: $(<landedSatoshis>) satoshis paid to the landing address.

convertTransaction.name: Converted
convertTransaction.description: $(convertTokenAmount) tokens paid to the owner for $(<landedSatoshis>) satoshis.

giveBackTransaction.name: Given back
giveBackTransaction.description: The landed satoshis returned to the owner as BCH.

convertInput.name: Landed coin
convertInput.description: The landed coin being converted. Holds $(<landedSatoshis>) satoshis and no tokens.

giveBackInput.name: Landed coin
giveBackInput.description: The landed coin being returned. Its sequence number carries the relative lock of $(<returnAfter>) blocks.

landingOutput.name: Landed coin
landingOutput.description: $(<landedSatoshis>) satoshis that can only leave to the owner.

ownerTokenOutput.name: Tokens to owner
ownerTokenOutput.description: $(convertTokenAmount) tokens paid to the owner. Must be output 0.

converterPayoutOutput.name: Payout to converter
converterPayoutOutput.description: The landed satoshis and the rest of the token coin, received by the converter at output 1.

giveBackOutput.name: Returned to owner
giveBackOutput.description: The landed satoshis returned to the owner as BCH, less the network fee.

landingLockingScript.name: Landing address
landingLockingScript.description: Pays out only to the owner: as tokens at or above the minimum rate (convert), or as BCH once the coin is $(<returnAfter>) blocks old (giveBack).

scripts.convertChecks: OP_INPUTINDEX OP_0 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_TXINPUTCOUNT OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENAMOUNT OP_ROT OP_MUL OP_0 OP_UTXOVALUE OP_ROT OP_MUL OP_GREATERTHANOREQUAL OP_NIP OP_NIP

scripts.landingContractBytecode: selectorIsConvert OP_IF convertChecks OP_ELSE giveBackChecks OP_ENDIF

tokenOutputSatoshis.name: Token output satoshis
tokenOutputSatoshis.description: Satoshis carried by the token output paid to the owner. Paid by the converter.

landedSatoshis.name: Landed satoshis
landedSatoshis.description: Satoshis the payer sends to the landing address.

ownerLockingScript.name: Owner locking script
ownerLockingScript.description: Full locking bytecode of the owner address, the only place a landed coin can go.

tokenCategory.name: Token category
tokenCategory.description: Category of the fungible CashToken the owner accepts, in display byte order (as block explorers show it).

rateNum.name: Rate numerator
rateNum.description: Minimum token base units the owner receives per rate denominator satoshis.

rateDen.name: Rate denominator
rateDen.description: Satoshis that the rate numerator refers to. Must be greater than zero.

returnAfter.name: Return age
returnAfter.description: Blocks a landed coin must wait before it can be given back as BCH.

converterLockingScript.name: Converter receiving locking script
converterLockingScript.description: Where the converter receives the landed satoshis and the rest of its token coin.

converterCoinSatoshis.name: Converter coin satoshis
converterCoinSatoshis.description: Satoshis of the token coin the converter spends at input 1.

converterCoinTokens.name: Converter coin tokens
converterCoinTokens.description: Token amount of the coin the converter spends at input 1. Must be at least the amount paid to the owner.

convertFeeSatoshis.name: Convert fee
convertFeeSatoshis.description: Satoshis the converter leaves for the network fee of the convert transaction.

giveBackFeeSatoshis.name: Give back fee
giveBackFeeSatoshis.description: Satoshis kept back from the returned value for the network fee. The covenant allows at most 1000.

resources.name: Original landing contract
resources.description: The CashScript contract of the Sampan landing address that this template implements.
